newsitem.title: DUBAI: Minor fire at Dubai Aluminium, output unaffected.
newsitem.headline: Minor fire at Dubai Aluminium, output unaffected.

text.p: A small fire broke out this week at Dubai Aluminium Co Ltd (Dubal) but caused no loss of output, Dubal corporate relations manager Khalid Essa Buhumaid said on Thursday.
"On Tuesday there was a minor fire in one of our transformers...it didn't affect operations and there were no casualties," he told Reuters.
A senior Dubal official said initially they had expected the fire to disrupt output, but as it had been quickly put out, production was not affected.
"There has been no impact on output or on our customers," he said.
Government-owned Dubal is in the process of expanding annual capacity by over 50 percent to 375,000 tonnes.
